session.title: How can I get summary git stats
session.task: how can i get summary git stats like lines added and lines deleted

steps.body: how can i get summary git stats like lines added and lines deleted

Use `git diff --shortstat` for a one-line summary.

Examples:

- Working tree vs `HEAD`: `git diff --shortstat`
- Staged changes only: `git diff --cached --shortstat`
- Between branches or commits: `git diff --shortstat main...HEAD`

For per-file counts, use `git diff --numstat`.
i want changes between main and head including non committed stuff

Use `git diff --shortstat "$(git merge-base main HEAD)"`. That compares from the branch point to the current working tree, so it includes committed, staged, and unstaged changes. Untracked files are not included by `git diff`; add them intentionally or count them separately.
